sentences.text: Ex-gratia for Permanent Disability/ Chronic Diseases/ Surgery/ Operation for the Construction Workers

**Scheme Brief Description:** "Ex-gratia for Permanent Disability/ Chronic Diseases/ Surgery/ Operation for the Construction Workers'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Dept., U.T. of DNH & DD, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for Permanent Disability/ Chronic Diseases/ Surgery/ Operation of the workers.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Citizen empowerment
**Where it applies:** Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Grant of Token Amount for Construction of House for the Construction Workers&quot; by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, registered beneficiaries of the board shall be provided with financial assistance for Permanent Disability/ Chronic Diseases/ Surgery/ Operation.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - **For Permanent Disability (100%):** ₹1,00,000/-. - **For Chronic Diseases Treatment:** Not exceeding ₹1,00,000/- in a year. - **For Surgery/Operation:** ₹40,000/-. **Note:** - For Chronic Diseases Treatment: Beneficiaries may receive self-treatment or treatment for their dependents as indoor patients from any hospital. - For Surgery/Operation: This benefit excludes operations related to maternity.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:** **Step 1:** Application for registration is to be made in the prescribed form and is to be accompanied by prescribed documents and a fee of not more than ₹50/-. **Step 2:** Application for registration has to be made to the officer authorized by the Board on this behalf. > **Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:** **Step 1:** Any registered worker can make an application in the prescribed [Form-V](https://www.daman.nic.in/websites/Printing-press-Daman/documents/2020/Extraordinary/Extra%20Ordinary%20No.%2029.pdf) (Refer Page No: 10) along with the mandatory documents (self attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Member Secretary (BOCWWB) for this benefit. > **Check Beneficiary Details:** Visit the [official website](https://bocwddd.in/welfare-schemes/dnh/disability-pension) and enter the “BOCW Registration No.” of the concerned beneficiary in the Search box. **Helpdesk:** BOCW Department: EMAIL ID: labour-dnh@nic.in PHONE NUMBER : 0260 - 2642374 ADDRESS: Old Circuit House Building, Opposite Bal Bhawan, Silvassa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli Pin:- 396230
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Labour & Employment Department
